verdict.rationale: UKVI runs digital services, including a visa-finder tool, eVisa online status accounts, an ID Check app and a processing-time checker, so AI-generated suggestions from a user's data are a conceivable feature. The axis therefore applies, but nothing in the evidence pack mentions AI-generated insights or recommendations; the visa-finder tool is described only as helping users find the correct visa, with no AI or personalised-insight capability stated.
